title: Origin check permits phishing drain
report_body: Wallet code: address owner; function pay(address payable to,uint amount) external {require(tx.origin==owner); (bool ok,)=to.call{value:amount}("");require(ok);} No other authorization exists. An owner calls an attacker contract believing it is a game; that contract calls wallet.pay(attacker, walletBalance). Local transaction trace shows tx.origin remains owner while msg.sender is attacker contract, draining all 8 ETH. The owner did not approve that transfer.
